subject.title: fix(session): add exponential backoff retry for stale-snapshot conflicts on concurrent session init

question: Should this renewed retry-budget PR and the older same-author https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100178 be closed together as superseded by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98835, or should maintainers sponsor a fresh current-main retry-budget direction?
rationale: The same mitigation was previously closed as superseded, but the same author now has two open retry-budget PRs, so closing only this PR would leave the duplicate cluster half-open.

options.title: Close the retry-budget duplicates together
options.body: Close this PR and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100178 as superseded by the merged identity-guard fix, with package parity left on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98416.

options.title: Sponsor a current-main retry design
options.body: Ask for a current-main reproduction after https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98835, then require the retry loop to cover lifecycle-rollover stale snapshots and include real behavior proof.

options.title: Adopt a narrow replacement
options.body: If maintainers still want defense-in-depth retries, replace both contributor branches with a focused maintainer-owned PR rather than landing this branch as-is.

recommendation.title: Close the retry-budget duplicates together
recommendation.body: Close this PR and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100178 as superseded by the merged identity-guard fix, with package parity left on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98416.

likelyOwner.reason: jalehman closed the prior retry-budget PR as superseded and contributed to the merged identity-guard fix, making them the clearest routing candidate for the duplicate retry-budget cluster decision.
